Pomodoro Timer

A full Pomodoro timer: configurable focus sessions, short and long breaks, session dots, cycle counter and an audible chime on every phase change.

A chime sounds on every phase change. The timer stays accurate in background tabs.

📖 How to use

  1. Set your focus, short-break and long-break lengths (defaults 25 / 5 / 15).
  2. Choose how many focus sessions come before a long break.
  3. Press Start — the timer runs Focus → Short break → … → Long break automatically.
  4. Skip a phase any time, or Reset to start a fresh cycle.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the Pomodoro technique?

Work in focused 25-minute blocks separated by 5-minute breaks; after 4 blocks take a longer 15–30 minute break. All durations are configurable here.

Does the timer keep running if I switch tabs?

Yes — it is driven by wall-clock timestamps, not by counting ticks, so it stays accurate even in a background tab.

Can I change the durations?

Yes: focus length, short break, long break and how many focus sessions come before a long break are all adjustable.
